note: These curves are the model the vault actually runs — the mean long/flat vote across the whole trend+vol-gate family, no fitted parameters, so in-sample == out-of-sample. The edge is drawdown reduction, not beating the asset on every entry: see the cohort block — a deposit made into a dip before a rally usually LAGS holding, while a deposit before a crash almost always beats it. Absolute sats-vs-hold ranges from outperformance (BTC/ETH/XRP) to underperformance in strong trends; the consistent win is shallower drawdowns.

cohort.note: Across every possible deposit day. 'rally' = entries in the top 25% of forward asset moves (bought a dip before a rip); 'crash' = bottom 25% (entered before a drop). beat = share gained more of the coin than holding.
